{{verse|chapter=17|verse=32}} And vvhen they had heard the re{{ls}}urrection of the dead, certaine in deede mocked, but certaine {{ls}}aid, Vve vvil heare thee againe concerning this point. {{verse|chapter=17|verse=33}} So Paul vvent forth out of the middes of them. {{verse|chapter=17|verse=34}} But certaine men ioyning vnto him, did beleeue: among vvhom vvas al{{ls}}o {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ Dyony{{ls}}ius Areopagita.}}∷ {{sup|‖}} Diony{{ls}}ius Areopagîta, and a vvoman named Dámaris, and others vvith them.⊣

Searching the {{ls}}criptures.''] {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The people may not iudge of the {{ls}}en{{ls}}e of Scriptures.}}The Heretikes v{{ls}}e this place to proue that the hearers mu{{ls}}t trie and iudge by the Scriptures, whether their teachers and preachers doctrine be true, and {{ls}}o reiect that that they find not in the Scriptures. as though here the {{ls}}heepe vvere made iudges of their Pa{{ls}}tors, the people of the Prie{{ls}}ts, and men and women of al {{ls}}ortes, euen of S. Paules doctrine it {{ls}}elf: Which were the mo{{ls}}t foli{{ls}}h di{{ls}}order in the world. And they did not therfore read the Scriptures of the old Te{{ls}}tament (for none of the nevv vvere yet extant commonly) to di{{ls}}pute vvith the Apo{{ls}}tle, or to trie and iudge of his doctrine, or vvhether they {{ls}}hould beleeue him or no: for they were bound to beleeue him and obey his word, vvhether he alleaged Scripture or no, and whether they could reade or vnder{{ls}}tand the Scriptures or no. but it was a great comfort and confirmation for the Ievves that had the Scriptures, to finde euen as S. Paul {{ls}}aid, that Chri{{ls}}t vvas God, crucified, ri{{ls}}en, and a{{ls}}cended to heauen: which by his preaching and expounding they vnder{{ls}}tood, and neuer before, though they read them, and heard them read euery Sabboth. {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The comfort of Chri{{ls}}tian men by hearing or reading the Scriptures.}}As it is a great comfort to a Catholike man, to heare the Scriptures declared & alleaged mo{{ls}}t euidently for the Churches truth again{{ls}}t Heretikes, in Sermons or othervvi{{ls}}e. And it doth the Catholikes good & much confirmeth them, to vew diligently the places alleaged by the Catholike preachers. Yet they mu{{ls}}t not be iudges for al that, ouer their owne Pa{{ls}}tors, whom Chri{{ls}}t commaundeth them to heare and obey, and by vvhom they heare the true {{ls}}en{{ls}}e of Scriptures.

This {{ls}}uper{{ls}}tition ({{ls}}aith S. Augu{{ls}}tine) {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text={{lang|grc|δεισιδαίμονας}}. ''Aug. de con{{ls}}.
